parameters.query:
=UPDATE publications SET
  wp_title      = '{{ String($('Parse JSON').item.json.content.wp_title).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  wp_body_html  = '{{ String($('Parse JSON').item.json.content.wp_body_html).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  wp_excerpt    = '{{ String($('Parse JSON').item.json.content.wp_excerpt).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  wp_categories = ARRAY[{{ ($('Parse JSON').item.json.content.wp_categories || []).map(c => "'" + String(c).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::text[],
  wp_tags       = ARRAY[{{ ($('Parse JSON').item.json.content.wp_tags || []).map(t => "'" + String(t).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::text[],
  fb_caption    = '{{ String($('Parse JSON').item.json.content.fb_caption).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  ig_caption    = '{{ String($('Parse JSON').item.json.content.ig_caption).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  hashtags      = ARRAY[{{ ($('Parse JSON').item.json.content.hashtags || []).map(h => "'" + String(h).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::text[],
  image_url     = '{{ String($json.url).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  status        = 'pending'
WHERE id = '{{ $('When Called by Another Workflow').item.json.id }}'::uuid
RETURNING id, status;
